# Travelio Web Application — Comprehensive Feature & Interface Specification Report

**Generated by**: Explorer 2 (Specification Miner)  
**Date**: 2026-08-28  
**Project**: Travelio — Curated Journeys Single Page Application (React + Vite + TypeScript)  
**Target Output**: Google AI Studio compatible React SPA with zero SSR overhead and full feature parity.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Architecture Overview

The Travelio web platform is a modern, boutique luxury travel booking and curation portal. Originally built as a Framer Next.js prototype, the project is being transformed into a high-performance, modular **React + Vite + TypeScript Single Page Application (SPA)** designed for seamless integration and live preview within **Google AI Studio**.

### Key Architectural Pillars
1. **Zero SSR Overhead**: Clean client-side rendering with lightning-fast Vite HMR, pure TypeScript interfaces, and zero heavy server-side dependencies.
2. **Complete Content & Visual Parity**: Faithfully replicates all 19 curated tours, 5 tour categories, 9 global destinations, 8 traveler stories, 4-step booking process, animated statistics, interactive inquiry modal, and luxury editorial design system.
3. **Interactive Polish**: Real-time multi-dimensional search & filtering (by keyword, category, price, duration), animated mobile navigation drawer, interactive accordion itinerary viewer, and form validation with instant user feedback.
4. **Google AI Studio Optimization**: Standard root file structure (`package.json`, `index.html`, `vite.config.ts`, `src/`, `public/`), clean asset management, and zero binary bloat (>1MB files excluded from git tracking).

## 3. Edge Cases & Interactive State Matrix

| # | Feature | Input / Trigger Condition | Expected Observed Behavior | Handling & Fallback Strategy |
|---|---------|---------------------------|----------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | Search Bar | User searches non-existent query (e.g. "Antarctica 99") | Tour explorer shows 0 results | Display clean Empty State: "No tours found matching '{query}'. Try clearing your search or switching categories." with a prominent "Reset All Filters" button. |
| 2 | Category Filter | User toggles active category button again | Deselects category filter | Switches back to "All Tours" (shows all 19 tours) without layout jumping. |
| 3 | Tour Detail Modal | User presses `Escape` key while modal is open | Modal dismisses smoothly | Event listener on `window.keydown` handles `Escape`; returns focus to previously active trigger element. |
| 4 | Plan a Trip Modal | User clicks outside modal backdrop (overlay) | Modal dismisses without submitting | Backdrop click handler with `e.target === e.currentTarget` check prevents accidental dismissal when clicking modal content. |
| 5 | Mobile Nav Drawer | User opens drawer and scrolls background | Background body does not scroll | Set `document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'` on open; reset to `''` on close. |
| 6 | Form Validation | User submits empty "Plan a Trip" form | All required fields highlight with errors | Focus immediately moves to first invalid field (`fullName`); inline error text displayed in red (`#EF4444`). |
| 7 | Form Email Field | User enters malformed email (e.g. "john@com") | Field shows validation error on blur or submit | Displays "Please enter a valid email address." and applies red border. |
| 8 | Form Guest Counter | User decreases guests count below 1 | Decrement button is disabled (`opacity-50 pointer-events-none`) | Minimum guest count clamped to 1; maximum clamped to 20. |
| 9 | Tour Card Pre-fill | User clicks "Book This Tour" on "Cherry Blossoms of Kyoto & Nara" | Plan a Trip modal opens with Destination ("Japan") and Category ("Nature") pre-selected | Modal state accepts `initialData: { destination: string, category: string, tourTitle: string }`. |
| 10 | Newsletter Form | User submits valid email in footer newsletter | Instant success message displayed inline | Replaces input with "✓ Thank you for subscribing! Check your inbox soon." without page reload. |
| 11 | Viewport Scaling | Window resized from Desktop (1440px) to Mobile (375px) | Fluid transition from grid to stacked cards; navbar switches to hamburger | Responsive CSS utility classes (`hidden md:flex`, `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3`). |
| 12 | Image Load Error | Tour image fails to load or offline | Fallback gradient with travel placeholder icon | `onError` handler on `<img>` tags loads fallback image asset. |

## 4. TypeScript Interfaces & Data Models

### 4.1. Core Entities

```typescript
export type TourCategory = 'Cities' | 'Nature' | 'Adventure' | 'Honeymoon' | 'Wildlife';

export type DestinationCountry = 
  | 'Japan' 
  | 'Morocco' 
  | 'Iceland' 
  | 'Maldives' 
  | 'China' 
  | 'Brazil' 
  | 'Canada' 
  | 'Tanzania' 
  | 'USA' 
  | 'Other';

export interface ItineraryDay {
  day: number;
  title: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface Tour {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  category: TourCategory;
  location: DestinationCountry;
  price: number; // in USD
  priceFormatted: string; // e.g. "$3,290"
  duration: string; // e.g. "7 D / 6 N"
  days: number;
  nights: number;
  rating: number; // e.g. 4.9
  reviewsCount: number; // e.g. 128
  image: string; // cover image path
  images: string[]; // gallery images
  overview: string;
  note?: string;
  highlights: string[];
  itinerary: ItineraryDay[];
  inclusions: string[];
  exclusions: string[];
}

export interface CategoryInfo {
  id: string;
  name: TourCategory;
  slug: string;
  count: number;
  image: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface DestinationInfo {
  id: string;
  name: DestinationCountry;
  slug: string;
  region: string;
  toursCount: number;
  image: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface TravelerStory {
  id: string;
  author: string;
  location: string;
  tour: string;
  category: TourCategory;
  rating: number;
  avatar: string;
  image: string;
  quote: string;
}

export interface BlogPost {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  title: string;
  category: string;
  date: string;
  readTime: string;
  image: string;
  excerpt: string;
}
```

### 4.2. Form & Interactive State Interfaces

```typescript
export interface PlanTripFormData {
  fullName: string;
  email: string;
  phone: string;
  destination: DestinationCountry | '';
  category: TourCategory | 'All' | '';
  travelDates: string;
  guestsCount: number;
  budget: string;
  message: string;
}

export interface FormValidationErrors {
  fullName?: string;
  email?: string;
  destination?: string;
  travelDates?: string;
  general?: string;
}

export interface FilterState {
  searchQuery: string;
  category: TourCategory | 'All';
  destination: DestinationCountry | 'All';
  maxPrice: number;
  sortBy: 'recommended' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'duration';
}

export type ModalType = 'none' | 'plan-trip' | 'tour-detail' | 'mobile-menu';

export interface ModalState {
  type: ModalType;
  selectedTour?: Tour | null;
  initialFormValues?: Partial<PlanTripFormData>;
}
```

### 5.3. Process Steps & Animated Key Metrics

#### 4-Step Process ("How We Plan Your Journey")
- **Step 01 — Tell Us Your Dream**: Share where you want to go, what moves you, and how you like to travel. No rigid packages, just a collaborative conversation.
- **Step 02 — Curate Your Itinerary**: Our destination specialists design a bespoke day-by-day roadmap with boutique stays and insider experiences.
- **Step 03 — Refine & Finalize**: We fine-tune every reservation, private transfer, and local guide until every detail is effortless.
- **Step 04 — Travel & Immerse**: Embark on your trip with complete peace of mind, backed by our 24/7 dedicated concierge.

#### Key Metrics ("Our Journey in Numbers")
- **12,000+** Happy Travellers (Crafting unforgettable memories worldwide since 2009)
- **60+** Unique Tour Packages (From budget adventures to private luxury escapes)
- **15+** Years of Experience (Perfecting meaningful travel experiences since 2009)
- **98%** Repeat Booking Rate (Most travelers return to explore with us again)

## 7. Form Specifications & Validation State Machine

### 7.1. "Plan a Trip" Inquiry Form

| Field Name | Type | Required | Validation Rule | Error Message | UX Behavior / Notes |
|------------|------|----------|-----------------|---------------|---------------------|
| `fullName` | `text` | Yes | `length >= 2` | "Please enter your full name (minimum 2 characters)." | Trims leading/trailing whitespace |
| `email` | `email` | Yes | `/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/` | "Please enter a valid email address." | Real-time lowercase transformation |
| `phone` | `tel` | No | Optional, checks valid digits if entered | "Please enter a valid telephone number." | Formatted placeholder `+1 (555) 000-0000` |
| `destination` | `select` / `chips` | Yes | Non-empty string | "Please select your preferred destination." | Pre-fills if opened from Tour Card or Country pill |
| `category` | `chips` | No | One of `Cities`, `Nature`, `Adventure`, `Honeymoon`, `Wildlife` | N/A | Default: matches selected tour or "Custom" |
| `travelDates` | `text` / `select` | Yes | Non-empty string | "Please specify your intended travel season or dates." | Suggests seasons (e.g. "Autumn 2026", "Spring 2027") |
| `guestsCount` | `number` | Yes | `1 <= count <= 20` | "Guests count must be between 1 and 20." | Interactive `+` and `-` stepper buttons |
| `budget` | `select` | No | Selection range | N/A | Options: "$2k - $5k", "$5k - $10k", "$10k+", "Luxury Tier" |
| `message` | `textarea` | No | Optional notes (up to 1000 chars) | N/A | Character counter displayed |

### 7.2. Submission Flow
1. **Idle State**: Form displays empty or pre-filled values. Submit button is enabled.
2. **Validating**: On submit click, runs validation against all rules. If invalid, displays inline error badges and focuses the first invalid field.
3. **Submitting**: Shows spinner icon and disables inputs (`isSubmitting = true`).
4. **Success State**: Replaces form with a confirmation card:
   - Green checkmark badge with gentle bounce animation
   - "Thank You, {fullName}!"
   - "Your trip inquiry for {destination} has been received. Our destination concierge will contact you at {email} within 24 hours."
   - Reference Code: `TRV-2026-{random 4 digits}`
   - "Explore More Tours" dismiss button.

## 9. Google AI Studio & Vite Compatibility Verification

To guarantee instant import and live preview within **Google AI Studio Build Mode**:
1. **Standard Directory Layout**:
   - `package.json` with scripts: `"dev": "vite"`, `"build": "tsc && vite build"`, `"preview": "vite preview"`
   - `index.html` at root referencing `/src/main.tsx`
   - `vite.config.ts` configured with `@vitejs/plugin-react`
